title: trichilia elegans subsp. richardiana
intro: Trichilia elegans subsp. richardiana, commonly known as the Yellow Satinwood or Yellow Satinwood Balsam, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Trichilia elegans subsp. richardiana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include trichilin, trichiliol, and limonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties.
